subject: 房价
claim_text: 上海和深圳房价将于2026年末见底，2026-2028年累计上涨15%
evidence_quote: We project cumulative price appreciation returns of 15% for SH and SZ during 2026E-28E (approximately 5% per annum ), with the majority of gains anticipated in 2027-2028E, broadly in line with income growth trends and assuming no material deterioration in housing affordability.

subject: 房价
claim_text: 上海和深圳将引领全国楼市复苏，2026年末见底，领先其他一二线城市6-24个月
evidence_quote: We expect SH/SZ to lead the national housing recovery, bottoming out in late 2026 and outpacing other tier-1/2 cities by 6-24 months.

subject: 房价
claim_text: 上海和深圳楼市将在2026年四季度全面复苏
evidence_quote: Following HK's housing market recovery, we believe SH and SZ are likely to see broad recovery by 4Q26

subject: 开发商与房企
claim_text: 若核心市场价格回升，中国开发商估值有望追赶港股同业大幅重估
evidence_quote: If property prices start to uptick in their core markets, we expect re-rating will be more meaningful for these developers to catch up with their HK peers.

subject: 开发商与房企
claim_text: 覆盖的优质国企开发商2028年核心盈利平均上调5%，净资产值及目标价上调2%
evidence_quote: We now model 15% property price increase from end-25 to end-28 for both cities, leading to an average 5%, 2% and 2% increase in 2028E core earnings, end-26E NAVs and 12-month NAV based target prices for our DP coverage universe.

subject: 开发商与房企
claim_text: 优质开发商ROE从2025年2%提升至2028E的6%
evidence_quote: We also expect ROE to improve to 6% by 2028E vs. 2% in 2025 for stronger developers on median.

subject: 库存与去化
claim_text: 上海和深圳二手房挂牌量下降，供应将减少
evidence_quote: property agents had noted declining secondary listing balance since 4Q25, and we expect secondary supply to reduce, partially driven by improving residential rental yield which incentivizes home-owners to rent out rather than sell as US lessons suggested

subject: 库存与去化
claim_text: 上海和深圳新房库存压力有限，去化年限与香港相当或更低
evidence_quote: In near-to-mid term , we see limited inventory pressure in SH and SZ: 1) new homes: n new land supplies in core areas of SH and SZ turned incrementally scarce and overall, total inventory years (incl. raw land) in the two cities stand similarly as/lower than c.5 years in HK as of end-25

subject: 购房者情绪
claim_text: 若A股行情延续，股市财富效应将推动上海深圳购房需求及房价回升
evidence_quote: if the A-share rally were to continue, we believe there is a likelihood for improved housing demand in SH and SZ supported by stock market wealth effect as well as confidence recovery, which will direct housing prices once again to echo the capital market.

subject: 开发商与房企
claim_text: 重申买入华润置地、金茂、中海及绿城，因沪深敞口高、投资效率改善
evidence_quote: We reiterate our Buy rating on CRL, Jinmao, COLI and Greentown, driven by their higher exposure to SH and SZ, alongside clearer visibility of improving land investment efficiency since 2024 to support their cash margin/ROE expansion

subject: 开发商与房企
claim_text: 给予新城、金地、华侨城、万科卖出评级，因流动性压力及销售利润率下滑
evidence_quote: Sell rating on Seazen, Gemdale, OCT, and Vanke (relative Sell), due to more pressured liquidity management relative to peers and sustained headwinds from declining DP sales and margins, stemming from a more adverse digestion of legacy inventory.

subject: 开发商与房企
claim_text: 给予招商蛇口、保利、龙湖中性评级，风险回报均衡、估值合理
evidence_quote: Neutral rating on CMSK, Poly, and Longfor, reflecting a balanced risk/reward profile given ongoing challenges in their DP business, offset by disciplined balance sheet management and current fair valuation

subject: 房价
claim_text: 全国房价2026-2027年仍将下跌3%、2028年持平，与沪深15%上涨形成对比
evidence_quote: We now model 15% property price increase from end-25 to end-28 for both cities (vs. nationwide -3%/-3%/0% yoy)

subject: 房价
claim_text: 历史上香港上涨季度后，上海深圳未来四个季度有74%-81%概率出现上涨
evidence_quote: In 46/50 cases of the sample periods (or a 74%/81% chance, respectively), SH and SZ delivered positive average QoQ performance in the ensuing 4 quarters.

subject: 购房者情绪
claim_text: 内地高净值买家配置资金正回流中国核心楼市
evidence_quote: Potential turning tide in high-net-worth buyer allocation, as Centaline data suggest Mainland buyers accounted for 25% of HK housing transactions in 2025 (or close to 50% of luxury property sales), with volume/value up 20%/8% yoy (third consecutive year of growth), signaling these globally oriented investors are re-weighing their property portfolio back toward Chinese core markets

subject: 成交量

evidence_quote: we expect the recent strength in secondary real-time sales in the 25 major cities to gradually decelerate in the coming months on a y-y basis, leading to 5-7% y-y growth for full-year 2026, versus +14% y-y in 4M26

subject: 成交量

evidence_quote: 3Q26: Sales may drop further on seasonality, with a potentially larger q-q decline than in previous years, reversing y-y growth back into negative territory, although the favorable base may result in only a 5-10% y-y decline.

subject: 成交量
claim_text: 新房销售未来数季同比维持负增长，全年跌幅高个位数
evidence_quote: we expect primary home sales volume to remain negative y-y in the coming quarters due to reduced saleable resources at developers, although a favorable base may narrow the YTD decline to high-single-digit %, versus -13.1% y-y in 3M26

subject: 房价
